title: V-8 ENG 350 CU. IN. SPEC. HI-PERF.- GENERATOR & PUMP MOUNTING
summary: LT1 350 high-performance engine: generator (alternator) with its fan and pulley, and the A.I.R. (air injection / smog) pump with its brace. The pump pivots on a long bolt and nut through its lower bracket and is adjusted by a bolt through the slotted brace; the brace's lower end sits on a stud near the generator, held by a lock washer and nut. Generator pulley and fan are held by the generator's own shaft nut (no separate callout).

parts.name: PUMP ASM.
parts.name_expanded: A.I.R. (air injection reactor / smog) pump assembly

fastening.to: engine/generator mounting area below the generator pulley
fastening.note: Main view: stud [5] (triangle 2) is installed with a lock washer [4] behind the brace; the lower end of A.I.R. pump brace [7] goes over the stud, then lock washer [4] and nut [6] (triangle 3). What the stud threads into is not clear in the drawing.
View A: bolt [10] (triangle 2) with lock washer [4] and plain washer [9] goes through the slotted upper end of brace [7] into the A.I.R. pump [8] (belt adjustment).

fastening.to: pump mounting bracket on the engine
fastening.note: View A: long pivot bolt [11] passes through the pump bracket and the pump [8] mounting ears; nut [12] (triangle 4) on the far end.

Pulley [3] and fan [2] go on the generator shaft and are held by the production generator shaft washer and nut (filled-square GENERATOR labels; nut carries triangle 1). No callout for that nut/washer – they come with the generator.
Generator [1] mounts with production brackets and the production brace (labelled PROD. BRACE); half-filled circle = assemble same as production.

Stud [5]: drawing shows washer [4] on both sides of the brace lower end; the stud's anchor point is hidden.
